Form-object and official-draft genre train. Two new public tools compose the Korean government draft forms (별지 제1호서식 일반기안문 / 제2호서식 간이기안문) into generic document-plan blocks from the regulation's public structure (clean-room): compose_official_draft and compose_simple_draft. Three regulation-derived contracts are enforced by the composition itself — the approval table has exactly as many cells as signing approvers (시행규칙 제7조제4항), the 결문 label vocabulary is not printed (별지 제1호서식 비고), and selection items use the [ ] + check convention rather than a check-box form object (별표 4 제10호). The core floor moves to 5.7.0 for the new check-box authoring primitives (add_check_box / list_check_boxes / set_check_box), whose emission shape was measured against real Hancom.
